PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday SEPTEMBER 12, 2019
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Administration of Oath to Newly Appointed Planning Commissioner Dean Henderson
4. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery
Commissioner French, Henderson and Smith
5. Review of Agenda
6. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
7. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
8. Consent Calendar
8A. Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of August 8, 2019.
8A
9. Public Hearings
9A. Tentative Tract Map 74967
Pacific Land Company, Applicant
A request to subdivide an approximately 8.5-acre vacant site into 28 lots for the purpose of constructing 28 detached single-family residences located east of the alignment of 20th Street West, south of Avenue P-8, and north of the Amargosa Channel (APN 3003-004-022).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-038 TTM 74967 adopting the Mitigated Negative Declaration that has been prepared pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), which indicates that the project has the potential for an adverse impact on the environment but with mitigation measures applied to the project any potential impacts will be reduced to a level of insignificance. Perry Banner, Contract Planner
9A
9B. Conditional Use Permit 19-012
Mike Neis, Applicant
A request to establish a heavy automotive repair shop within an existing building, located at 40222B La Quinta Lane, Suite 104.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-037 approving Conditional Use Permit 19-012 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
9B
9C. Conditional Use Permit 19-004 / Site Plan Review 19-006
St. Mary’s Catholic Church, Applicant
A request to construct a Minor Communication Facility at 1600 East Avenue R-4 (St. Mary’s Catholic Church).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-036 approving CUP 19-004 and SPR 19-006, and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Clarence “Skip” Smith, Assistant Planner
9C
9C. Conditional Use Permit 19-004 / Site Plan Review 19-006
St. Mary’s Catholic Church, Applicant
A request to construct a Minor Communication Facility at 1600 East Avenue R-4 (St. Mary’s Catholic Church).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-036 approving CUP 19-004 and SPR 19-006, and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Clarence “Skip” Smith, Assistant Planner
10. Staff Communications Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
11. Planning Commission Communications
12. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, October 10, 2019, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber Regular Planning Commission Agenda
September 12, 2019
